Chapter 1143: 11: Winning Over (Request For Subscription)

Chapter 1143: Chapter 11: Winning Over (Request for Subscription)

“The map… is it extending?”

Within the internal universe, Lin Yuan descended in his avatar, observing the changes in the beast skin map before him.

As the inner aura of the Xuanhuang Universe gradually dissipated, the map on the surface of the beast skin was visibly extending rapidly.

The map originally occupied only one-fifth of the beast skin; now it was expanding, one-fourth, one-third… eventually half of the beast skin’s surface was covered by the map.

“In addition to the mausoleum, many other areas have appeared…”

Lin Yuan carefully observed, and many regions had descriptions introduced.

For example, a place called Futu Tower, a location for body refining, where any being approaching the area would be shrouded by the Futu Power.

Even those as powerful as a Great Saint would be trapped momentarily.

There is also a place called the Nine Realms Pavilion, which connects to nine small worlds separately opened by the Xuanhuang, imprisoning some wonder-life forms nurtured by the Chaos Void.

For the Xuanhuang’s daily research.

…

“With this map in hand, once I enter the Xuanhuang Universe, I will definitely gain many advantages.”

Lin Yuan smiled, while other powerhouses, even those Chaos Great Saints, would be clueless once inside, not knowing where to head.

To be precise, they are unaware of the value of those regions’ positions.

Rushing in recklessly, it is very likely to mistakenly enter places like Nine Realms Pavilion or Futu Tower.

The Nine Realms Pavilion connects to nine small worlds; if a Chaos Great Saint mistakenly enters, it may take a lot of effort to get out.

Futu Tower is even more so, as the Futu Power is no weaker than the chaotic evolution forces, specifically used by the Profound Xuanhuang for body refining; the Great Saint would surely find it unbearable once trapped.

And as the Xuanhuang Universe initially opens, every moment is extremely precious; being trapped for a while? By the time they come out, many precious resources may have already been taken.

Step by step, they fall behind.

Later Great Saints can only watch helplessly.

“Once I enter, follow this route…”

Lin Yuan, according to the map, devised his route upon entering the Xuanhuang Universe.

The places these routes pass through contain many treasures, oddities, and weapons, maximized by Lin Yuan for profit.

To prevent himself from randomly appearing at some position in the universe, Lin Yuan directly formulated more than ten routes, covering almost every contingency.

“Ultimately, I must head to the mausoleum, where it’s likely the Xuanhuang has stored the most precious treasures.”

Lin Yuan looked at the center region of the map, which was also the initially exposed mausoleum.

“Yet, during this opening of the Xuanhuang Universe, not a single master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm has come?” Lin Yuan glanced outside, thinking to himself.

Every being that masters and refines the Xuanhuang Secret Realm generates a slight mutual response among themselves.

Refining the Xuanhuang Secret Realm is tantamount to being a disciple of the Xuanhuang, belonging to the Profound Xuanhuang line, naturally allowing them to identify each other.

“Indeed, with so many Cosmic Eras having passed, even if there were still masters of the Secret Realm, they may not be aware of the Xuanhuang Universe’s emergence, and even if they knew, they might not make it here on time.”

Lin Yuan thought internally.

He was aware this universe was the Xuanhuang Universe due to the beast skin with the engraved map, which resonated with each other.

Without this beast skin, Lin Yuan could not determine that the newly emerged Postnatal Universe was the Xuanhuang Universe.

If the distance was too far, and the cost too great to come over, it would likely not be worth meddling in this situation.

Moreover, becoming the master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm isn’t an easy task; Lin Yuan achieved it due to his extraordinary comprehension.

But for other beings within different universes? It’s exceedingly difficult.

With 33,333 Xuanhuang Secret Realms, how many have been mastered is another question altogether.

…

In the outside world.

As time and space collapsed on the outer edge of a corner of the Xuanhuang Universe, revealing a hint of its inner aura, the many powerhouses who had been waiting for a long time felt a thrill.

Lin Yuan’s true body was also watching intently.

“It should be a few more days.”

Lin Yuan thought internally; this corner’s space-time collapse had stirred a temporal storm within the universe; to wait until it is enterable, many more days are likely required.

“Hmm?”

Most of Lin Yuan’s attention was focused on a corner of the Xuanhuang Universe when he suddenly noticed a presence approaching swiftly.

“Divine Wind Venerable?”

Lin Yuan recognized the identity of the other, a well-known peak Chaos Venerable.

Besides the Divine Wind Venerable, there were two other peak Chaos Venerables following behind.

“Your excellency, don’t be alarmed, we mean no harm.”

Divine Wind Venerable immediately transmitted his voice, stopping not far away without approaching further.

“What do you seek?” Lin Yuan asked, looking at them.

“Your excellency must have noticed the extraordinariness of this Postnatal Universe? Its creator was undoubtedly an extraordinary Great Saint.” Divine Wind Venerable said, “However, the majority of treasures and rarities within this Postnatal Universe are destined to fall into the hands of the nine Great Saints.”

Divine Wind Venerable glanced at the nine figures closest to the secret realm.

Initially, the auras of the Chaos Great Saints were somewhat restrained, but now? As they were about to enter the Xuanhuang Universe, the nine Chaos Great Saints no longer hid, instead freely releasing their terrifying auras.

“We Chaos Venerables can only follow behind the Great Saints and scrape for what little we can; even so, we must still guard against other Venerables.”

Divine Wind Venerable sighed.

Lin Yuan, upon hearing this, remained silent.

Among the nine Chaos Great Saints, competition was necessary, and among the Chaos Venerables, competition was equally required.

In fact, the level of competition among Venerables far exceeds that of the Great Saints; after all, there are only nine Great Saints who will surely claim the majority of resources and treasures within the Xuanhuang Universe.
